inpainting.prompt:
the tail of a young dragon with burnished bronze-gold scales, wearing a tail ornament of bronze bells: a snug band of thick braided deep sea-blue rope with small turquoise beads wrapped tightly around the tail, and hanging from it three small round bells of bright shining polished yellow bronze, each bell with a dark slit and a tiny pale pink seashell charm, clean dark ink outline around the band and every bell, (scales on the band:-2).

Style: a painterly young-adult fantasy novel cover illustration, gouache and acrylic on paper with rich painted light, soft cel shading with warm and cool colour variation inside every shape, appealing slightly stylised proportions and expressive faces, in a sun-bleached Mediterranean palette of marble white, warm terracotta, olive green and deep Aegean blue with small burnished gold accents; dramatic but never gory or horrific, adventurous and a little theatrical, the feel of a Greek-mythology adventure book for teenagers. Line work: one clean medium-weight dark ink outline of even thickness runs continuously around the whole silhouette, every contour smooth, confident and closed, interior lines finer than the outline, hair drawn as a few thick solid locks with inked edges, wing membranes opaque with inked edges, nothing glows, mists or smokes into the background, the figure is isolated on a flat plain pure white background with no cast shadow, (sketchy lines:-2) (rough brush strokes:-2) (scratchy hatching:-2) (thick heavy outline:-1.5) (shadow:-2).

cleanup: hand clean-up after extraction with tools/art/overlay_clean.py (erase polygons/circles in stage px, drop specks, re-soften cut edges): one extract per part, united (max alpha): band as recorded above; bell L --pos 145,772 135,804 --neg 170,761 157,790 160,815 --box 126 752 165 815; bell M --pos 185,807 182,836 --neg 203,784 160,815 210,841 --box 165 795 205 855; bell R --pos 240,822 242,847 --neg 237,794 260,834 225,835 --box 224 805 263 860 (one SAM call for the whole ornament kept the repainted scales between the bells)
note: inpainting and extraction mask = the slot mask united with itself shifted down 22 px (tools/art/extmask.py <stage> queue 22 <out>), so the hanging bells are not cut flat by the slot bottom (the first try, seeds 1131-1133 on the plain slot, cut them)
raw_crop_note: <item>_raw.png = the inpainted result cropped to raw_crop (stage px x0, y0, x1, y1); <item>_mask.png = the overlay's alpha over the same crop (white = item). After repainting the mask: python tools/art/overlay_raw.py rebuild <item>.png (raw pixels with the mask as alpha, pasted at (x0, y0) on a transparent picture the stage's size).
